title: Quality Studio and Agent Studio Integration
summary: Decision dossier for converging Quality Studio review semantics with Agent Studio pipelines without merging product identities. It recommends a QS-owned finding envelope and portable change-review provider executed on Studio's existing fenced Review Plane, while Studio retains delivery grading, council policy, deterministic gates, integration, and lane authority. It verifies the current url-preview-embed navigation contract with QS as sender and Studio as the display-only receiver.

implementationTasks.title: Define the shared quality finding envelope and pin the preview sender contract
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement Slice 1 from docs/operations/studio-integration/index.html in the Quality Studio repository. Add a versioned immutable finding-envelope JSON schema and CLR contract under the core library, reusing the review-meta v2 finding vocabulary with discriminated standing-unit and task-change subjects. Keep grades and mutable dispositions outside the envelope. Add converters from ReviewFinding and FindingDeltaItem, fixtures for source-located and location-free task findings, and full schema round-trip tests. Document and unit-test the existing url-preview-embed sender payload for repo/path/kind navigation. Preserve review-meta v1/v2 compatibility and do not change Studio behavior or API routes.

implementationTasks.title: Export portable no-write Quality Studio change-review evidence
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement Slice 2 from docs/operations/studio-integration/index.html in the Quality Studio repository. Extend quality diff with --format json --output <path> while preserving --no-write and exit codes 0/1/2. The artifact must bind base/head, include policy and prompt provenance, usage, deterministic delta, agent judgement status, and shared finding envelopes. With --no-write it must not write .quality/changes or alter the worktree/index. Prove the contract in a temporary real Git fixture, including provider unavailable behavior. Do not add a new HTTP scheduler.

implementationTasks.title: Run Quality Studio change review as shadow evidence in Agent Studio
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: Implement Slice 3 from docs/operations/studio-integration/index.html in Agent Studio. Add an opt-in post-quality-change-review step on the existing Review Plane, executed against the fenced expected Result-SHA and integration baseline. Persist the QS JSON as digest-checked ReviewArtifactEvidenceDto and distinguish provider unavailable, provider infrastructure failure, and product findings. Keep the step reporting-only: it must not change council, lane, integration admission, existing A-D grading, or existing aspect execution. Add component/backend tests and cohort telemetry needed for at least 20 paired completed coding tasks.

implementationTasks.title: Adopt structured delivery findings and distinct grade names in Agent Studio
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: After the Slice 3 cohort is accepted, implement Slice 4 from docs/operations/studio-integration/index.html. Persist shared finding envelopes from the Studio delivery-grade producer while retaining legacy text-sentinel reads. Make council consume the structured projection, feed QS change-review evidence into the delivery-grade prompt as prior evidence, and rename user-facing Quality Grade to Delivery Grade without renaming stored files, tags, or API fields. Present Remote Review as Review outcome. Do not remove any aspect in this slice. Prove legacy compatibility, missing-finding escalation, and both themes.

implementationTasks.title: Replace the duplicate Studio code-quality aspect with QS evidence
implementationTasks.promptMarkdown: After paired operator review finds no lost blocking code issue or subject mismatch, implement Slice 5 from docs/operations/studio-integration/index.html. Replace only the narrow Studio code-quality aspect with the QS provider result. Retain requirement-fit, tests-and-evidence, documentation-impact, Delivery Grade, council, build/test gates, and integration policy. Route QS findings through Studio orchestration policy so QS never mutates a task directly. Add Open in Quality Studio evidence links using repository/path/kind/fingerprint and a per-project rollback switch for one release window. Prove one code-quality model call is removed and rollback does not rewrite history.

verificationTask.evidence: Real-browser embedded navigation and real no-write CLI artifact verified against the v1 contracts.

nextSlice.reason: The Review Plane, ReviewArtifactEvidenceDto, task state, and cohort telemetry do not exist in the Quality Studio repository.
